summary: Throughout 2021 Indonesian enforcement agencies (KKP fisheries patrols, Bakamla and the Navy) seized foreign boats for illegal fishing, 75 in all according to a year-end count by DFW Indonesia, of which 39 were Vietnamese, 27 Malaysian, 6 Philippine and 1 Taiwanese, with half the arrests in the Natuna Sea; among them, on 24 December 2021 the Bakamla patrol ship KN Pulau Dana-323 stopped the Vietnamese boat KG 2118 TS with 20 crew in the North Natuna Sea and escorted it to Batam.
